en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a narrow old European street lined with multi‑story buildings with shutters and balconies. A tall medieval tower rises above the houses in the background. In the foreground are two figures, one pushing a handcart loaded with goods and another in a dark cloak and hat walking along the street. Printed captions identify the scene as a street in Trento, specifically Via S. Maria Maggiore. There is a red postage stamp in the upper‑right corner with cancellation marks.
